assets.name: spruce
assets.prompt: Create ONE isolated snow-covered Norway spruce tree game sprite for InisLand medieval Nordic snowy village. Input image 1 is STYLE reference: match the red-haired chibi character's smooth hand-painted anime game illustration, confident dark brown outlines, simplified chunky forms and soft warm highlights; do NOT draw character. Input image 2 is CAMERA reference only, elevated orthographic 2.5D view downward around 35-45 degrees, horizontal front axis, visible upper surfaces of snow-covered boughs, no horizon, no isometric diagonal. Dense tapered teal-green spruce, broad tiered boughs, ivory-blue rounded snow pillows, short visible warm brown trunk, approachable beautiful winter village aesthetic. Less microdetail than realistic concept art, readable at small game scale, no pixel art. Tree top to full trunk base fully visible with generous 8 percent transparent margin all sides. Trunk base centered horizontally. No ground plane, no background, no baked cast shadow, no people, no text, only one tree. True transparent RGBA.

assets.name: pine
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE isolated snow-covered tall northern European Scots pine (Pinus sylvestris) forest game sprite, for InisLand medieval SCANDINAVIAN village. Reference image ONLY defines art style: smooth illustrated game painting, dark warm brown contours, soft highlights, teal foliage and blue ivory snow. Match this reference style precisely. Species silhouette DIFFERENT from spruce: ONE long perfectly upright vertical reddish-grey rough-bark trunk, slender oval irregular crown at upper half with short natural upward boughs around a single vertical leader; scattered visible branch gaps and dusty snow caps; rough wild Scandinavian boreal forest tree. Overall narrow and tall silhouette with visible straight lower trunk, no ornamental pruning. Top-down orthographic 35-45 degree game camera, visible upper surfaces, no horizon. Full tree top and trunk base completely visible, centered trunk foot, 10 percent transparent margins all sides. True transparent RGBA, no ground/shadow/background/people/text. ABSOLUTELY NO bonsai, niwaki, Japanese garden pine, Chinese landscape pine, horizontal tiered cloud pads, umbrella crown, twisted S-shaped trunk, sculpted branches, low spreading trunk, decorative garden tree. This is an upright wild European forest conifer. Only ONE tree.
